Tuesday Oct 21st from 7pm, with Heads of AI / research leaders joining from
Zeitview, Zefr, Doordash etc. We'll keep the setup more intimate than CVPR
capping attendance to 15 people.

subject: ICCV this year to talk scaling ML pipelines
text:
Hi [NAME],

Will anyone from [COMPANY] be at ICCV this year? Thought there's a good
chance you might be, and I'd love to grab a coffee if so.

Would be great to talk about [COMPANY]'s Series B and your plans going
forward. We find that's usually around the stage when teams start reaching
out to Encord to help scale their ML pipelines, as many find that early,
in-house systems work well to start, but struggle with robustness (e.g.
breaking videos into frames for annotation rather than handling them
natively).

Would be great to hear where [COMPANY]'s at and share how we've helped
teams like Flock Safety, LVT, and Milestone Systems unify their data
curation, annotation, and model evaluation through our video-native
platform.

Will you be around ICCV? Happy to grab a quick coffee and trade notes on
the space.

subject: partner with [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

We recently onboarded Mytra who was moving from simulation to real-world
data collection to train their perception model. At the time they lacked a
system to effectively index, auto-label and QA to keep up with the
surging training data volume. I saw the demo of your pick & place robots -
curious if you're anticipating similar challenges at [COMPANY]?

In case Encord is new to you... we help warehouse robotics teams (e.g.
Pickle Robot, Osaro, Mytra, Fox Robotics, etc) automate their annotation
pipelines as they scale. Many customers in the space leverage our
model-assisted workflow and our labeling editor's support across 2D (image
& video) and 3D point cloud data.

Keen to hear your thoughts on training data as you scale - i'm flexible
Tuesdays to Thursdays if you're open to chat.
